Assigned Readings & Foundational Scholarship

Please review the following foundational scholarship and technical documentation prior to our hands-on laboratory sessions:

  • Chacon, Scott, and Ben Straub. Pro Git (2nd ed.). Chapters 1–3: "Getting Started", "Git Basics", and "Git Branching". Apress, 2014. [Open Access]
  • The Unicode Consortium. "Europe-I: Modern and Ancient Scripts — Greek." In The Unicode Standard, Version 15.0, Core Specification, Section 7.2. Mountain View, CA, 2022.
  • Robinson, Peter. "The Digital Revolution in Scholarly Editing." In Electronic Textual Editing, edited by Lou Burnard, Katherine O'Brien O'Keeffe, and John Unsworth, pp. 92–107. Modern Language Association of America, 2006.
  • Davis, Mark, and Ken Whistler. Unicode Standard Annex #15: Unicode Normalization Forms. Unicode Technical Report, 2023.

Digital editions and open-access links are accessible via the StFX Library proxy and linked resources.
